fixes.fix: @validates field validators use the loaded attribute key (incl. dotted attribute paths) to find and, on failure, pop the value
fixes.why: On the snapshot, with attribute= the invalid value stayed in ValidationError.valid_data (popped by field name), and with a dotted attribute the validator was silently never run.

fixes.fix: Schema validators / post-processors with many=True pair items with originals safely when lengths differ or input is not a list (_originals_for instead of zip(strict=True)/zip_longest)
fixes.why: On the snapshot a pass_collection pre_load that changes list length, or a dict passed with many=True and skip_on_field_errors=False, crashed with a bare ValueError from zip(strict=True).

fixes.fix: dump(many=True) materializes one-shot iterators when dump processors exist so pass_original gets the real items
fixes.why: Dumping a generator with a pass_original post_dump gave original=None for every item because the generator had already been consumed.

fixes.fix: only/exclude naming an unknown nested parent (e.g. 'zz.y') raises ValueError('Invalid fields') instead of KeyError
fixes.why: The input is already an error, so this only changes a raw KeyError into the documented ValueError; it is a better message, not a change in outcome.

fixes.fix: class Meta: fields listing an undeclared name raises ValueError('Invalid fields') instead of KeyError
fixes.why: The input is already an error, so this only turns a raw KeyError 'b' into a clear ValueError.

fixes.fix: unknown=INCLUDE no longer overwrites a deserialized field value whose attribute name equals an unknown input key
fixes.why: With data_key='b' on field 'a', input {'b':1,'a':'not-an-int'} returned the raw unvalidated 'not-an-int', which lets unvalidated data overwrite a validated field.

fixes.fix: Nested.__deepcopy__ drops the cached _schema so per-instance only/exclude are applied
fixes.why: Once the class-level Nested.schema had been accessed (e.g. by introspection tools), later Parent(only=('child.id',)) instances reused the cached schema and ignored only/exclude.

fixes.fix: TimeDelta deserialization of NaN raises ValidationError instead of ValueError
fixes.why: 'nan' input crashed with an uncaught ValueError instead of returning a validation error.
fixes.upstream_commit: 7dff08f Raise ValidationError (not ValueError) for NaN in TimeDelta (#3004)

fixes.fix: Date field rejects datetime.datetime instances passed through unchanged
fixes.why: datetime is a subclass of date and passing it through unchanged is defensible; rejecting it is a policy change that could break existing callers.

fixes.fix: Function field without a serialize callable is skipped on dump instead of calling None
fixes.why: The docstring promises load-only behaviour when serialize is omitted, but dump crashed with TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not callable.

fixes.fix: OneOf/NoneOf materialize one-shot iterables (choices, labels, iterable) so they can be iterated more than once
fixes.why: Passing a generator, e.g. OneOf(c.value for c in Color), exhausted it while building the error text, so every value was then rejected (or never matched for NoneOf).

fixes.fix: ContainsOnly/ContainsNoneOf treat unhashable elements tested against set choices as non-members instead of raising TypeError
fixes.why: A list element in user input crashed validation with TypeError: unhashable type instead of producing a ValidationError or passing.

fixes.fix: experimental Context keeps its reset tokens in a ContextVar stack so one instance can be nested or used concurrently
fixes.why: Re-entering the same Context instance overwrote self.token, so exit raised RuntimeError 'Token has already been used once'; a shared instance used across threads or tasks hits the same problem.

fixes.fix: OrderedSet.__eq__ returns NotImplemented for non-iterables instead of raising TypeError
fixes.why: OrderedSet([1]) == None raised TypeError, which breaks the equality contract; the impact is small because OrderedSet is internal.

fixes.fix: class_registry.register replaces the entry for a class redefined in the same module instead of keeping the stale one
fixes.why: On the snapshot, lookup by short name returned the first definition while lookup by full path returned the latest, which is inconsistent; but keeping the first entry was a deliberate dedup choice, and the case is mostly notebooks and tests.

fixes.fix: Field 'validate' docstring no longer says returning False raises ValidationError
fixes.why: The doc change is correct (returning False has not been supported since 4.0, per the CHANGELOG) but it changes no code.
